title: 每任务工作区 + 可写共享工作区硬链接：布局、发布、锁、manifest、冲突与回滚
evidenceLevel: G1 offline filesystem module (real temporary filesystems and hard links; no live host/model)

build.buildCommand: npm run check (tsc --noEmit + node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts + tsc -p tsconfig.build.json + node --check client/index.js)

layout.artifacts: unchanged: {dataDir}/workspaces/<taskId>/artifacts/note.txt is only published by LocalArtifactStore from the task area

disclosure.unexpectedConflictOutcome: unknown/blocked, shared index not advanced, task mirror retained for reconciliation

cases.injectionPoint: 共享文件已链接到任务 shared/，任务原地写该链接
cases.expected: canonical 内容立即变化；declare expectedChanges 后 synced 且 index 更新
cases.observed: canonical changed immediately; synced with declared change; index sha updated

cases.injectionPoint: 任务在 shared/ 下新建 nested/new.txt
cases.expected: canonical 出现新文件；index 记录；不静默丢弃
cases.observed: published new.txt by hard link; canonical readable; index updated

cases.injectionPoint: 任务删除 shared/ 中文件链接
cases.expected: 默认只移除任务侧链接，canonical 保留
cases.observed: task-link removed; canonical kept; change recorded as task-link-removed

cases.injectionPoint: 任务删除链接 + 显式 ownerDecision delete-shared
cases.expected: canonical 被受控删除；index 移除；回执记录 decision
cases.observed: canonical deleted only under explicit owner decision; index updated

cases.injectionPoint: 任务原地写未在 expectedChanges 声明
cases.expected: status unknown；index 不变；mirror 保留；不猜
cases.observed: unknown with unexpected-modification; index untouched; mirror retained

cases.injectionPoint: 任务 A 持有共享锁时任务 B prepare
cases.expected: 任务 B 得到 WORKSPACE_LOCKED；A release 后 B 可 prepare
cases.observed: second prepare blocked with WORKSPACE_LOCKED; released lock allows next task

cases.injectionPoint: 注入 deviceOf 使 shared root 与 workspaces root 设备不同
shared root 中存在符号链接条目
cases.observed: SYMLINK_FORBIDDEN; outside file never linked or read as workspace content
blocked MANIFEST_TAMPERED; lock released; no publish

cases.injectionPoint: snapshot=true 后原地修改，再 rollback
cases.expected: rolled-back；canonical 内容恢复；index 恢复；锁释放
cases.observed: rolled-back; canonical content/hash restored; index rebuilt; lock released
task-only layout; publish no-shared; artifact still observable

boundaries.externalConcurrentWriters: not supported; exclusive advisory lock + single-writer assumption only

worktree.method: git worktree add --detach HEAD + 仅复制本切片（src/adapters/artifacts/shared-workspace.ts、SHARED_WORKSPACE.md、index.ts 导出、tests/workspace-shared-hardlink.test.ts、本证据 JSON）；node_modules 符号链接；.local/ombre 仅符号链接复用既有 pinned Python/Ombre 夹具（未安装依赖）

commands: npm run check  # tsc --noEmit && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node --check client/index.js

zeroSkipEvidence.note: 隔离 worktree 全量 check 0 失败 / 0 跳过；pinned Python/Ombre 夹具以既有 .local/ombre 符号链接复用，未安装依赖。

discardedPreparation.note: 在补上 ownerDecision 回执/限制说明前，曾用一个仅含旧切片副本的 worktree 跑过一次全量 check；该次未完成即被停止且不作为证据（其计数/日志未采用）。
